text: dsh-computer-use-macos 为 DSH 桌面端提供 macOS 原生应用操作和可选浏览器自动化。它通过 Harness CUA 与兼容桥接层，让 PTC 会话发现应用、读取界面状态和截图，并执行点击、拖动、滚动、输入及快捷键操作；浏览器适配器可连接显式配置的 loopback CDP 浏览器，查看页面并操作标签。适合希望在 DSH 中操作 Mac 应用或浏览器的用户。需要 macOS 14+、Node.js 24.9+、Harness 0.2.2-rc.1；原生使用需系统授权，浏览器功能需配置。

dsh-computer-use-macos lets DSH sessions control Mac apps through Harness CUA: discover apps, inspect accessibility state and screenshots, click and type. It can optionally control a configured CDP browser. Requires macOS 14+, Node.js 24.9+, Harness 0.2.2-rc.1, and system permissions.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness on macOS：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Capabilities](docs/capabilities.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

An independent community plugin with a familiar app/window API, native macOS accessibility and screenshots, and opt-in Chromium DOM automation. Native execution uses the official MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness CUA provider; this project adds an original compatibility facade and a browser adapter. It contains no OpenAI implementation code and is not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek.

text: dsh-computer-use-macos README · Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness on macOS：**This is not a complete clone of Codex's private runtime.** Locked-desktop control, OpenAI's browser extension and signed-in profile integration, Appshots, browser-history authorization, and WebMCP are not supplied. See the capability matrix before installation.
section: Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness on macOS

text:
dsh-computer-use-macos README · Requirements：- macOS 14 or newer, Apple Silicon or Intel; an unlocked desktop.
- Node.js 24.9+ and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** (the tested prerelease).
- A model route declaring image input for screenshots.
- Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions for the official `DSH Computer Use.app`, followed by Harness's separate app-consent prompts.
- Optional browser control: a browser **you explicitly started** with a loopback CDP listener and a dedicated profile. Browser control is disabled until its endpoint is configured.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Requirements：The official provider dependency ships signed, precompiled native helpers. This plugin neither recompiles nor re-signs them. Older Harness 0.2.1 profiles are intentionally excluded because their CUA contracts differ.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Install：From a reviewed checkout or a release tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-computer-use-macos-0.1.0.tgz
```

Or install a reviewed Git commit (replace `<commit>` with the release's full SHA):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yw5579358/dsh-computer-use-macos#<commit>
```

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Install：Built `lib/` files are committed, so Git installs do not require a prepare/install script. Enable only one computer-use provider per profile; remove a competing provider before adding this bundle. Restart Harness when the host does not support hot reload.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Install：Use a PTC session. The bundle mounts the native provider with `agentPreset: ptc` and retains the official authorization flow. This plugin does not silently switch existing sessions or their model. A GUI host that supports the CUA Client page exposes its permission controls; source/headless users must complete TCC permissions on the Mac itself.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Discover index：For Harness's experimental **Custom plugin indexes**, add this explicitly trusted source:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yw5579358/dsh-computer-use-macos/codex/initial-release/plugin-index.json
```

The format-1 index pins the tested plugin source to an immutable commit. This is a self-hosted community index, not an official curated listing.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Use native apps：Methods include app discovery, explicit window selection, AX observations, screenshots, click/hover/drag, value replacement, literal text selection, advertised secondary actions, Unicode input, shortcuts, and plain/HTML clipboard paste with the upstream clipboard-preservation semantics.

Important differences from the Codex interface:

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Use native apps：- Screenshot results retain `{bytes, mimeType, pixelWidth, pixelHeight, windowId}`; the image is already admitted by the Host. Do not print Base64 or upload it a second time.
- `scroll({x, y, deltaLinesX, deltaLinesY})` uses bounded line deltas. It does not accept page counts or an AX scroll-target index.
- `click(index, {key:'super', durationMs:800})` maps to native modifiers and a bounded click hold.
- AX reads are full observations, not Codex's incremental diff format.
- Keyboard/paste require the intended focus. Raw Unicode HTML has an AppKit encoding limitation in the tested text field; prefer plain text. See the validation report.
- After an input action, **including a failed one**, observe again before further input. Do not automatically retry an uncertain action.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Optional browser tool：Browser configuration and examples are in [the browser guide](docs/browser.md). The supported model path is `computer_browser` through the Harness tool pipeline, with declarative locator operations. Access is opt-in, profile-wide and bounded by Harness's normal tool policy; it is **not** per-domain authorization. CDP can access all tabs in the configured browser, so use an isolated profile.
dsh-computer-use-macos README · Optional browser tool：The lower-level `./browser` export is a developer library for testing or embedding, not a substitute for the Host tool approval pipeline.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Test and develop：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run check
npm run test:browser
npm pack

The browser integration test starts an owned headless Chrome/Chromium process with a temporary profile and a local fixture page. Set `DSH_TEST_CHROME` when the standard macOS Chrome executable is unavailable. It never uses your daily browser profile. Native desktop testing requires explicit system grants and an owned fixture; a mock test does not establish real desktop behavior.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Test and develop：See [validation results](docs/testing.md), [research sources](docs/research.md), [contribution instructions](CONTRIBUTING.md), and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-computer-use-macos README · Remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-computer-use-macos
```

Removal does not revoke macOS TCC permissions or erase upstream Harness application grants. Revoke those separately in System Settings and the Harness CUA permission page. No tokens, personal screenshots, session logs or browser profiles belong in this repository.

dsh-computer-use-macos README · DeepSeek Harness macOS Computer Use 插件：[English](README.md) · [能力对照](docs/capabilities.md) · [安全说明](docs/security.md)

独立社区插件：复用 Harness 官方、MIT 开源的 macOS 原生 CUA，增加原创的 Codex 风格应用/窗口 API 和可选浏览器适配层。没有复制 OpenAI 的实现，也不代表 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 官方。

支持应用与窗口选择、AX 界面树、窗口截图、点击、悬停、拖动、滚动、Unicode 输入、快捷键、值替换、文本选区、辅助动作及上游剪贴板保护流程。每次输入后要求重新观察，失败输入也不能自动重试。

**不宣称完整复刻 Codex 私有运行时。** 锁屏控制、OpenAI 浏览器扩展及其已有登录 Profile 集成、Appshots、浏览历史授权和 WebMCP 不在本版本能力内。
section: DeepSeek Harness macOS Computer Use 插件

text:
dsh-computer-use-macos README · 环境与安装：需要 macOS 14+、Node 24.9+、Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`、支持图片输入的模型，以及用户为官方 `DSH Computer Use.app` 授予辅助功能和屏幕录制权限。系统授权与 Harness 逐应用授权是两层独立权限；插件不能自行授予。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-computer-use-macos-0.1.0.tgz
```

也可从本项目 GitHub 安装，建议固定发布 commit。仓库包含已构建的 `lib/`，不执行安装/prepare 脚本。一个 profile 只能启用一个 Computer Use provider。

在 PTC 会话中使用：

dsh-computer-use-macos README · 插件发现：在实验功能 **Custom plugin indexes** 中添加可信索引：

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yw5579358/dsh-computer-use-macos/codex/initial-release/plugin-index.json
```

索引将安装来源固定到测试过的 commit；这是自建社区索引，不是官方精选收录。

dsh-computer-use-macos README · 浏览器：默认关闭。仅连接用户显式配置的 loopback CDP 浏览器，推荐独立临时 Profile。正式模型调用经过 Host 的 `computer_browser` 工具及 Harness 普通审批/日志流程。CDP 能访问该浏览器的所有标签，loopback 限制不等于站点级授权。详见 [浏览器配置](docs/browser.md)。

不会自动接管日常 Chrome；清理只处理插件自己创建且没有标记保留的标签，不关闭外部浏览器进程。公开的 `./browser` 是开发者底层库，不替代 Host 审批。

dsh-computer-use-macos README · 测试与发布：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run check
npm run test:browser
npm pack

浏览器测试使用独立 Chrome/Chromium 临时 Profile 与本地夹具。原生桌面测试需要用户系统授权，验证记录见 [测试报告](docs/testing.md)。已有 `0.2.1-rc.5` 不属于支持范围，应先升级，或使用独立 profile 测试。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-computer-use-macos`。卸载不自动撤销 macOS 权限与 Harness 保存的应用授权，请分别在对应权限页面撤销。
